laptop.msg: link font-size 12px vs ref 7.82222px (Δ4.2) [declared: The reference scales link type strictly with viewport width, reaching 7.8px at 1024, 5.9px at 768 and 3.0px at 390. That is legible only for its own two-word uppercase labels and fails WCAG for arbitrary generated content. This reconstruction keeps the fluid ramp but floors it at 12px.]

tablet.msg: height 46.0 vs ref 34.4 (Δ11.6px) [declared: The reference rail is 34px tall at 768 and 17.5px at 390 because its height is also pure vw. A 17.5px bar cannot hold a touch target (44px minimum). This reconstruction floors the rail at 46px below 860px and moves the links into a panel.]
